title: Acute Effects of Alpha-glycerylphosphorylcholine (A-GPC) on Lower Body Muscular Performance.
official: Effects of Alpha-GPC on Lower Body Muscular Performance and Activation.
summary: The purpose of the present study was to examine the effectiveness of acute A-GPC supplementation on upper and lower body muscular strength, endurance, power, and global levels of activation.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Recreationally-trained males, college-aged

Exclusion Criteria:

* If the subjects report: 1) cardiovascular disease, metabolic, renal, hepatic, or musculoskeletal disorders; 2) use of any medications; 3) use of nutritional supplements; 4) habitual use of caffeine (≥1 caffeinated beverage per day); 5) participation in another clinical trial or investigation of another nutritional product within 30 days of screening/enrollment.
